Garden Field Editor

Offline editor for IrisBG accession items. Edits export as an Action=U import file — nothing writes to the database directly.

Export the AccessionItem report from IrisBG and load the .xlsx here. Your data stays on this phone — it is never uploaded anywhere. Save your session often; a browser tab can't hold your work if it closes.

Task lists

Field photos

Photos captured against an accession item. Export gives one .zip (all photos named by item number, plus a manifest). On iPhone it opens the share sheet — choose Save to Files / iCloud Drive, or send it. Generate the IrisBG image import file on your PC from that zip.
